description: Defines classes and interfaces for QUIC crypto client stream, including base class QuicCryptoClientStreamBase and implementation QuicCryptoClientStream, with related interfaces for handshake and proof handling.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientStreamBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for QUIC crypto client stream handling handshake and crypto state.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientStream
classes.description: Concrete implementation of QUIC crypto client stream, managing handshake process, proof verification, and encryption states.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientStream::HandshakerInterface
classes.description: Interface for different crypto handshake protocols, including TLS and QUIC crypto.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientStream::ProofHandler
classes.description: Interface for handling proof verification callbacks.

methods.name: CryptoConnect
methods.description: Performs a crypto handshake with the server.

methods.name: num_sent_client_hellos
methods.description: Returns the number of client hello messages sent.

methods.name: IsResumption
methods.description: Indicates if the handshake was a resumption.

methods.name: EarlyDataAccepted
methods.description: Indicates if early data (0-RTT) was accepted.

methods.name: ReceivedInchoateReject
methods.description: Indicates if an inchoate REJ was received during handshake.

methods.name: ExportKeyingMaterial
methods.description: Exports keying material for cryptographic purposes.

methods.name: GetAddressToken
methods.description: Retrieves the address token.

methods.name: ValidateAddressToken
methods.description: Validates the address token.

methods.name: PreviousCachedNetworkParams
methods.description: Gets previous cached network parameters.

methods.name: SetPreviousCachedNetworkParams
methods.description: Sets previous cached network parameters.

methods.name: encryption_established
methods.description: Checks if encryption is established.

methods.name: one_rtt_keys_available
methods.description: Checks if 1RTT keys are available.

methods.name: crypto_negotiated_params
methods.description: Returns negotiated crypto parameters.

methods.name: crypto_message_parser
methods.description: Provides the crypto message parser.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Gets buffer size limit for a given encryption level.

methods.name: AdvanceKeysAndCreateCurrentOneRttDecrypter
methods.description: Generates a decrypter for the next key phase.

methods.name: CreateCurrentOneRttEncrypter
methods.description: Creates an encrypter for the current key phase.

methods.name: GetHandshakeState
methods.description: Returns current handshake state.

methods.name: OnOneRttPacketAcknowledged
methods.description: Handles acknowledgment of a 1RTT packet.

methods.name: OnHandshakePacketSent
methods.description: Handles event when handshake packet is sent.

methods.name: OnConnectionClosed
methods.description: Handles connection closure.

methods.name: OnHandshakeDoneReceived
methods.description: Handles event when handshake completion is received.

methods.name: OnNewTokenReceived
methods.description: Handles reception of new token.

methods.name: SetServerApplicationStateForResumption
methods.description: Sets application state for session resumption.

methods.name: BufferSizeLimitForLevel
methods.description: Gets buffer size limit for a specific encryption level.

methods.name: chlo_hash
methods.description: Returns the client hello hash.
